name: Student Priya

intro.text: I'm at the University of East Anglia, just out west. Our campus has concrete ziggurats and a lake full of rabbits. I'm studying the rabbits.

win: Oh. I'll write an essay about this.
after: UEA's halls look like Aztec pyramids. They're called the Ziggurats. They're listed. You can't change a single stair.
